query:
SELECT ms.slug, ms.name, 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl LIKE '%CBH-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ai_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl LIKE '%-front%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as front_photos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl LIKE '%mintcomic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mint_photos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl IS NULL OR mc.imageUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_image,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND mc.imageUrl != '' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%CBH-%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%-front%' AND mc.imageUrl NOT LIKE '%mintcomic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as other_images
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id 
GROUP BY ms.slug, ms.name
ORDER BY ms.id;
